why: issue 2215: `rclcpp::stamp_offset<M>::value`, the CDR byte offset of a message type's `stamp.sec` (0 when the type carries no stamp), read off the C++ message pack's `M::STAMP_OFFSET`. rclcpp has no counterpart: its subscriptions feed no contract age monitor. The typed registrations pass it in `nros_cpp_subscription_options_t::stamp_offset` so a C++ subscription feeds its topic's contracted age row as the Rust typed paths do. Machinery a component does not name.
